title: Cutty Sark: the fastest sailing ship of all time

sentences.en: The nineteenth century was a period of great technological development in Britain, and for shipping the major changes were from wind to steam power, and from wood to iron and steel.
sentences.zh: 十九世纪是英国科技大发展的时期,航运业的重大变革是从风力到蒸汽动力,从木材到钢铁。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The fastest commercial sailing vessels of all time were clippers, three-masted ships built to transport goods around the world, although some also took passengers.
sentences.zh: 有史以来最快的商业帆船是快艇,这是一种三桅船,用于在世界各地运输货物,尽管有些也载客。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: From the 1840s until 1869, when the Suez Canal opened and steam propulsion was replacing sail, clippers dominated world trade.
sentences.zh: 从 1840 年代到 1869 年,当苏伊士运河开通、蒸汽推进取代帆船时,快船主导了世界贸易。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Although many were built, only one has survived more or less intact: Cutty Sark, now on display in Greenwich, southeast London.
sentences.zh: 虽然建造了许多艘,但只有一艘或多或少完好无损地幸存下来：卡蒂萨克号,现在在伦敦东南部的格林威治展出。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Cutty Sark's unusual name comes from the poem Tam O ’Shanter by the Scottish poet Robert Bums.
sentences.zh: 卡蒂萨克号不寻常的名字来自苏格兰诗人罗伯特·邦斯 (Robert Bums) 的诗 Tam O’Shanter。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Tam, a farmer, is chased by a witch called Nannie, who is wearing a 'cutty sark’ - an old Scottish name for a short nightdress.
sentences.zh: 农民 Tam 被一个名叫 Nannie 的女巫追赶,她穿着“cutty sark”——苏格兰短睡裙的一个古老名字。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The witch is depicted in Cutty Sark’s figurehead - the carving of a woman typically at the front of old sailing ships.
sentences.zh: 女巫被描绘在卡蒂萨克号的船首雕像上 - 通常在旧帆船的前面雕刻一个女人。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In legend, and in Bums,s poem, witches cannot cross water, so this was a rather strange choice of name for a ship.
sentences.zh: 在传说中,以及在邦斯的诗中,女巫无法渡过水,所以这是对船的一个相当奇怪的选择。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Cutty Sark was built in Dumbarton, Scotland, in 1869, for a shipping company owned by John Willis.
sentences.zh: 卡蒂萨克号于 1869 年在苏格兰敦巴顿为约翰·威利斯 (John Willis) 拥有的一家航运公司建造。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: To carry out construction, Willis chose a new shipbuilding firm, Scott & Linton, and ensured that the contract with them put him in a very strong position.
sentences.zh: 为了进行建造,威利斯选择了一家新的造船公司 Scott & Linton,并确保与他们签订的合同使他处于非常有利的地位。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In the end, the firm was forced out of business, and the ship was finished by a competitor.
sentences.zh: 最终,该公司被迫停业,这艘船也被竞争对手完成了。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Willis’s company was active in the tea trade between China and Britain, where speed could bring shipowners both profits and prestige, so Cutty Sark was designed to make the journey more quickly than any other ship.
sentences.zh: 威利斯的公司活跃于中英之间的茶叶贸易,速度可以为船东带来利润和声望,因此卡蒂萨克号的设计目的是使旅程比任何其他船只都更快。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: On her maiden voyage, in 1870, she set sail from London, carrying large amounts of goods to China.
sentences.zh: 1870年,她的处女航从伦敦起航,载着大量货物前往中国。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: She returned laden with tea, making the journey back to London in four months.
sentences.zh: 她满载茶叶归来,四个月后回到伦敦。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, Cutty Sark never lived up to the high expectations of her owner, as a result of bad winds and various misfortunes.
sentences.zh: 然而,由于恶劣的风和各种不幸,卡蒂萨克号从未辜负主人的厚望。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: On one occasion, in 1872,the ship and a rival clipper, Thermopylae, left port in China on the same day.
sentences.zh: 有一次,1872 年,这艘船和一艘竞争对手的快船 Thermopylae 在同一天离开了中国港口。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Crossing the Indian Ocean, Cutty Sark gained a lead of over 400 miles, but then her rudder was severely damaged in stormy seas, making her impossible to steer.
sentences.zh: 横渡印度洋时,卡蒂萨克号领先了 400 多英里,但随后她的舵在波涛汹涌的大海中严重受损,导致她无法驾驶。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The ship’s crew had the daunting task of repairing the rudder at sea, and only succeeded at the second attempt.
sentences.zh: 船员们在海上修复舵的任务艰巨,直到第二次才成功。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Cutty Sark reached London a week after Thermopylae.
sentences.zh: 卡蒂萨克号在温泉关后一周抵达伦敦。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Steam ships posed a growing threat to clippers, as their speed and cargo capacity increased.
sentences.zh: 随着蒸汽船速度和载货量的增加,它们对快船的威胁越来越大。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In addition, the opening of the Suez Canal in 1869,the same year that Cutty Sark was launched, had a serious impact.
sentences.zh: 此外,1869年苏伊士运河的开通,即卡蒂萨克号下水的同年,也产生了严重的影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: While steam ships could make use of the quick, direct route between the Mediterranean and the Red Sea, the canal was of no use to sailing ships, which needed the much stronger winds of the oceans, and so had to sail a far greater distance.
sentences.zh: 虽然蒸汽船可以利用地中海和红海之间快速、直接的路线,但运河对帆船来说没有用处,因为帆船需要更强的海洋风,因此必须航行更远的距离。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Steam ships reduced the journey time between Britain and China by approximately two months.
sentences.zh: 蒸汽船将英国和中国之间的航行时间缩短了大约两个月。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: By 1878, tea traders weren’t interested in Cutty Sark, and instead, she took on the much less prestigious work of carrying any cargo between any two ports in the world.
sentences.zh: 到了 1878 年,茶叶贸易商对卡蒂萨克号不再感兴趣,相反,她承担了在世界任何两个港口之间运输任何货物的不太有声望的工作。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In 1880, violence aboard the ship led ultimately to the replacement of the captain with an incompetent drunkard who stole the crew’s wages.
sentences.zh: 1880 年,船上的暴力事件最终导致船长被一个无能的酒鬼取代,他偷走了船员的工资。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: He was suspended from service, and a new captain appointed.
sentences.zh: 他被停职,并任命了新队长。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This marked a turnaround and the beginning of the most successful period in Cutty Sark's working life, transporting wool from Australia to Britain.
sentences.zh: 这标志着卡蒂萨克号工作生涯中最成功时期的转变和开始,将羊毛从澳大利亚运输到英国。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: One such journey took just under 12 weeks, beating every other ship sailing that year by around a month.
sentences.zh: 其中一次这样的旅程花费了不到 12 周,比当年航行的所有其他船只都快了大约一个月。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: The ship’s next captain, Richard Woodget, was an excellent navigator, who got the best out of both his ship and his crew.
sentences.zh: 该船的下一任船长理查德·伍德盖特（Richard Woodget）是一位出色的航海家,他充分发挥了他的船和船员的才能。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: As a sailing ship, Cutty Sark depended on the strong trade winds of the southern hemisphere, and Woodget took her further south than any previous captain, bringing her dangerously close to icebergs off the southern tip of South America.
sentences.zh: 作为一艘帆船,卡蒂萨克号依赖于南半球的强劲信风,伍德盖特将她带到了比任何以前的船长更南的地方,使她危险地接近南美洲南端的冰山。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: His gamble paid off, though, and the ship was the fastest vessel in the wool trade for ten years.
sentences.zh: 不过,他的赌博得到了回报,这艘船是十年来羊毛贸易中最快的船只。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: As competition from steam ships increased in the 1890s, and Cutty Sark approached the end of her life expectancy, she became less profitable.
sentences.zh: 随着 1890 年代蒸汽船的竞争加剧,卡蒂萨克号接近其预期寿命,她的盈利能力下降。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: She was sold to a Portuguese firm, which renamed her Ferreira.
sentences.zh: 她被卖给了一家葡萄牙公司,该公司将她更名为费雷拉。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: For the next 25 years, she again carried miscellaneous cargoes around the world.
sentences.zh: 接下来的25年里,她再次载着各种货物环游世界。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Badly damaged in a gale in 1922, she was put into Falmouth harbour in southwest England, for repairs.
sentences.zh: 1922年,她在大风中严重受损,被放入英格兰西南部的法尔茅斯港进行维修。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Wilfred Dowman, a retired sea captain who owned a training vessel, recognised her and tried to buy her, but without success.
sentences.zh: 拥有一艘训练船的退休船长威尔弗雷德·道曼（Wilfred Dowman）认出了她并试图购买她,但没有成功。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: She returned to Portugal and was sold to another Portuguese company.
sentences.zh: 她回到葡萄牙并被卖给另一家葡萄牙公司。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Dowman was determined, however, and offered a high price: this was accepted, and the ship returned to Falmouth the following year and had her original name restored.
sentences.zh: 然而,道曼态度坚决,并提出了很高的价格：这个价格被接受了,该船于次年返回法尔茅斯,并恢复了原来的名字。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Dowman used Cutty Sark as a training ship, and she continued in this role after his death.
sentences.zh: 道曼使用卡蒂萨克号作为训练舰,她在他死后继续担任这个角色。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: When she was no longer required, in 1954, she was transferred to dry dock at Greenwich to go on public display.
sentences.zh: 1954 年,当不再需要她时,她被转移到格林威治的干船坞公开展示。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The ship suffered from fire in 2007, and again, less seriously, in 2014, but now Cutty Sark attracts a quarter of a million visitors a year.
sentences.zh: 这艘船曾于 2007 年遭遇火灾,并于 2014 年再次发生火灾,但情况不太严重,但现在卡蒂萨克号每年吸引 25 万游客。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

instructions: Questions 1-8: Do the following statements agree with the information given in Reading Passage 1?

items.prompt: Clippers were originally intended to be used as passenger ships
Cutty Sark was given the name of a character in a poem
The contract between John Willis and Scott & Linton favoured Willis
John Willis wanted Cutty Sark to be the fastest tea clipper travelling between the UK and China
Despite storm damage, Cutty Sark beat Thermopylae back to London
The opening of the Suez Canal meant that steam ships could travel between Britain and China faster than clippers
Steam ships sometimes used the ocean route to travel between London and China
Captain Woodget put Cutty Sark at risk of hitting an iceberg
After 1880, Cutty Sark carried ………….. as its main cargo during its most successful time
As a captain and ……………… , Woodget was very skilled
Ferreira went to Falmouth to repair damage that a ………… had caused
Between 1923 and 1954, Cutty Sark was used for …………….
Cutty Sark has twice been damaged by ……………. in the 21st century
